name: Telluric-Sabkha
description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond acid rain regions the sky stays the color of a bruise.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
The ore-body estimates keep being revised upward, which keeps the gun-runner schedules full.
